sources.name: EJDict-hand
sources.note: English-Japanese dictionary data, the primary source for Japanese glosses. Words missing from EJDict-hand have LLM-generated glosses (cross-checked by a second AI pass only, no native-speaker human review).

sources.name: New General Service List (NGSL) / New Academic Word List (NAWL)
sources.note: Known-word baseline (3,772 words). Words beyond this baseline are treated as new course content. The course title displays a rounded starting point (10,000) rather than this exact figure.

sources.name: JESC (Japanese-English Subtitle Corpus)
sources.note: Secondary example sentence source for words Tatoeba didn't cover (subtitle-derived parallel corpus). Words still missing an example after this have an LLM-generated one (aiGenerated:true on the individual example).

sources.name: CMUdict
sources.note: Pronunciation (IPA). ARPABET→IPA conversion is a custom implementation in this project (pipeline/arpabet_to_ipa.py).
